limitations: PASS applies only to the named local deterministic/fake-provider, SQL, API, static, web-library/build, upgrade and runtime-preflight proofs. A default-settings smoke also confirmed assessment_blueprint_enabled is false when the environment variable is unset; local Compose and CI/E2E opt in explicitly. Web library tests passed 402/402 with 907 expectations; typecheck and the Next 16.3.1 production build passed. The final upgrade proof emitted four PASS lines: cohort max safe-at, existing legacy owner continuation, separate enrolled/no-session student denial, and `upgrade_defaults__tum_owner_grantleri_ve_public_execute_temiz`, including an effective-ACL probe on a new app function created by another owner. The two-case runtime preflight proved both the LOGIN precondition and a real old dou_app connection surviving NOLOGIN until drain. Dedicated role-graph failure-case negatives and mixed-use different-legacy-paper/cross-course fixtures are not yet present. Real-browser/Playwright, real-provider holdout, managed-pooler staging, rollback rehearsal, GitHub Actions and all human approvals remain pending. This report is not release certification.
